senses.gloss: dwelling.—מְ׳ עמים (עכ״ום, מ׳ כותים) a dwelling that has been occupied by gentiles (in Palestine, which is unclean until examined and found free of corpses).
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 18:10">Tosef. Ohol. XVIII, 10</cite> <he>כיצר בודקין מ׳ הע׳</he> how is a vacated gentile dwelling examined?—
Ib. 6 כותיים עושים מ׳ הע׳ Samaritan inmates make a dwelling subject to the law of m’dor ha‘ammim. Ohol. XVIII, 9; a. fr.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 24b">R. Hash. 24ᵇ</cite> <he>מ׳ העליון</he> the upper story of the heavens; <he>מ׳ התחתון</he> the lower story (sphere of the heavenly bodies).
<cite ref="Niddah 31a">Nidd. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ התחתון</he> the lowest compartment of the womb.
